desc.en: Something unusual seems to have occurred in the palace...

desc.zh: 拜访祢衡，说服他应允刁难曹操一事。
desc.en: Visit Mi Heng and persuade him to agree to make things difficult for Cao Cao.

desc.zh: 曹操头痛已犯，大计已成，速速告知董承，是时候让太医出马了。
desc.en: Cao Cao's headache has struck. The grand scheme is ready. Quickly inform Dong Cheng—time for the imperial physician to act.

story.zh: 曹操挟天子以令诸侯，献帝又一次成为了权臣的傀儡。数日后，国舅董承收到一封密诏...
story.en: Cao Cao held the emperor hostage to command the warlords in his name, and Emperor Xian once again became the puppet of a powerful minister. Several days later, Imperial In-law Dong Cheng received a secret decree...

trigger.zh: 曹操、刘备存活。许昌属曹操。
trigger.en: Cao Cao and Liu Bei are alive. Xuchang belongs to Cao Cao.

forbidden.zh: 主角是董承时无法触发剧情。
forbidden.en: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Dong Cheng.

participate.zh: 【身属曹操势力】或【在野状态下与董承关系等级至少为2级】
participate.en: 【Belong to Cao Cao Faction】 or 【Free, with a Relationship level of at least Level 2 with Dong Cheng】

force.zh: 曹操身为君主并占领<许昌>
force.en: Cao Cao is Ruler and occupies <Xuchang>
